# Fade Out icon assets

This archive contains the local icon assets prepared for Fade Out.

- `macOS/AppIcon.appiconset/` — complete Xcode macOS app icon set, 16–1024 px.
- `macOS/MenuBarIcon.imageset/` — adaptive black template icon at 1x and 2x for the menu bar.
- `Windows/FadeOut.ico` — 256 px Windows executable icon.
- `source/Minimal Green Equalizer Icon.png` — original supplied app-icon artwork.
- `source/fadeout-menubar-assets/` — the complete supplied menu-bar export set.

The macOS template icon should remain marked as a template image so macOS automatically renders it correctly in light and dark menu bars.
